scenes.headline: How a model API doubles as a research instrument
scenes.sub: Arcee's Open Models API serves rivals' models beside its own Trinity.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Sesame! Arcee trains its own models, and its new API serves other labs' too. Here's how that works, and why.

scenes.text: Arcee serves other labs' open models next to its own Trinity, so it can learn which model users pick for which task, and why.
scenes.say: The idea: serve rivals' open models beside your own, and watch which one people pick for which task, and why.

scenes.title: The API as a feedback loop

steps.say: A person, or an agent in Arcee's nac harness, sends a task to the Open Models API.
It serves six open models: Arcee's own Trinity, beside DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi and Inkling.
Arcee sees which model people reach for: when the task is long, when it's cheap, when it has to be right.
Arcee says those insights will shape the Trinity models it builds next.

steps.note: nac sends every unit of work through a named dispatch
steps.say: And nac logs every unit of work as a named dispatch: a natural place to see which model gets which step.

left.title: No serving surface
left.say: Without a serving surface, a lab learns only from benchmarks and complaints.

right.title: Routing real workloads
items: Which model people reach for, per task
right.say: Routing real workloads, it sees which model people reach for instead of its own.

scenes.title: What an agent's bill is made of
scenes.text: bill = in x input price + out x output price
scenes.say: Why read the price table closely? A bill has two terms.

parts.note: tokens read, times the input price
parts.say: Tokens read, times the input price.

parts.note: tokens written: output costs 2x to 5x input here
parts.say: Plus tokens written, times the output price: two to five times the input price here.

scenes.title: Output price as a multiple of input
scenes.say: DeepSeek charges double for output. Trinity, three point two times. Kimi K3, five times.

scenes.label: Kimi K3's bill over DeepSeek-V4-Flash's, at 5M in and 25M out
scenes.note: its input price alone is 21× higher
scenes.say: At five million in and twenty-five million out, Kimi's bill is fifty times Flash's, though its input price is only twenty-one times higher.

scenes.text: An API can be a lab's research instrument, but its prices shape the very choices it measures.
scenes.say: An API can be a research instrument. But its prices shape the very choices it measures.

recap: Arcee serves rivals' models to watch what users pick
Those choices feed the next Trinity models
scenes.say: To recap: serve the rivals, learn from the choices, and read the output column.
